newsitem.title: USA: Valero Energy raises credit agreement.
newsitem.headline: Valero Energy raises credit agreement.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp said on Tuesday it has replaced its $300 million credit facility with a five-year, $835 million agreement with a group of banks led by Morgan Guaranty Trust Company and Bank of Montreal as agent banks.

The new credit facility will be used to finance a portion of the acquisition cost of Basis Petroleum Inc, to provide credit enhancement for the company's industrial revenue bonds, and to meet ongoing working capital needs, Valero said.
The bank credit facility will become the obligation of and be available exclusively to Valero Refining and Marketing Co upon its spin-off from Valero Energy Corp, Valero said.
